audit.summary: Two local reproducibility/reporting defects; video AUC definition coherent, benchmark and causal interpretation remain bounded.
limitations: P1 — Inference parser has history-dependent unmatched-response labels — Counterevidence: Historical benchmark evaluator unavailable; default may be implemented there

P1 — Inference parser has history-dependent unmatched-response labels — Alternative readings and counterevidence: An omitted historical evaluator may initialize a default correctly. Appendix A.1 also makes the video AUC mathematically coherent: 32 binary votes give 33 possible ranking scores, not merely balanced accuracy. Independently checked all four positive-negative pairs in the stated 16/32,24/32 versus 1/32,8/32 example are correctly ranked. No error in the definition of this AUC is established.
P2 — Timing-table dataset attribution does not match main AUC entries — Counterevidence: Caption typo or different run possible; raw run records absent

P2 — Timing-table dataset attribution does not match main AUC entries — Alternative readings and counterevidence: A caption typo, copied AUC column, or different run/configuration could explain this. No run provenance establishes the actually timed dataset. Appendix A.4 explicitly acknowledges LVLM performance decline; the report correctly distinguishes that admission and lower LVLM scores from the parser and table defects.
